messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — realtime_p99_regression in eu-west-1. 5m p99 = 2.4s (SLO 1.2s). Affected routes: /v1/generate (chat), /v1/stream. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.local/d/alerts/7723456666
oncall-amy: Acked. Paging eng-sre. Starting quick triage. :phone:
matt: Which models/variants are hot? per-route breakdown pls.
lee: Quick query ->
```
SELECT route, model_variant, p95, p99
FROM latency_metrics
WHERE region='eu-west-1' AND time > now()-5m
ORDER BY p99 DESC
```
Results: /v1/stream (gptx-16q): p95=0.9s p99=2.6s; /v1/generate (gptx-32): p95=0.7s p99=2.1s
jordan: Streaming clients reporting stalls and frequent reconnects. Tail lat spikes correlate with kvcache-misses on grpc pool.
matt: Can we isolate if it's infra (gpu/host) or model-level (kv cache, batching)? Any elevated GPU utilization or host OOMs?
lee: Checking hosts... `top`/nvidia-smi look normal. No OOMs. But observe increased queue latency on the runtime's batching queue for eu-west-1.
ops-bot: Autoscaler triggered +10 replicas at 7723456780 for cluster-eu-rt.
jordan: So backlog + batching means some requests wait for longer batches -> p99 jumps. Streaming also sensitive to that.
matt: Immediate mitigations: 1) change routing policy to prefer low-latency variant (gptx-8-q) for 15m; 2) temporarily reduce max_batch_size for /v1/stream; 3) increase ingress workers. Who can run the routing change?
oncall-amy: I'll apply routing change and reduce batch size. Jumping to bridge: zoom.us/j/incident-7723456666 (30m)
lee: Command for routing change (run):
```
redwoodctl route set --region eu-west-1 --route "/v1/stream,/v1/generate" \ 
  --policy latency-first --prefer-variants gptx-8-q --duration 15m
```
Applying now.
oncall-amy: Applied. Confirmed via API: policy=latency-first, expires=15m. :white_check_mark:
matt: Batch-size tweak: `redwoodctl config set --route /v1/stream max_batch_size=8 --region eu-west-1`
lee: Done. Also bumped runtime workers: `kubectl scale deployment/rt-worker --replicas=24 -n eu-west-1` -> scaled from 14 to 24. ops-bot reported scale event earlier.
jordan: Early signals: p99 dropping from 2.6s -> 1.3s over last 2 minutes, streaming reconnects reduced.
oncall-amy: Any customers reporting errors/impact? Support says a handful of EU customers saw timeouts at 10:12-10:18 UTC, mainly streaming sessions. No data exfil.
matt: Good. Keep an eye on error budget and SLO burn. Create incident ticket and severity. I'll open #inc-7723456666 and tag support + cs.
oncall-amy: Incident ticket created: INC-7723456666 (severity: sev2). Adding remediation steps and timeline.
ops-bot: Alert status -> recovered at 7723456890 (p99 back under threshold). Monitor for 30m.
lee: Metrics look stable but still elevated p95 by ~100-200ms. We'll keep routing policy for full 15m and then evaluate rollback.
jordan: Postmortem checklist: capture batching histograms, queue lat distribution, host allocation, and kvcache hit-rate around window. I'll start collecting traces.
oncall-amy: Handoff note for morning shift: continue monitoring eu-west-1 for 45m, if p99 >1.2s re-escalate to infra and consider rolling rollback of last runtime commit.
matt: Thanks team. Closing on-call bridge in 10m if stable. I'll ping once we confirm 30m steady. :pray:
